brief: Three proposals. One board meeting. 90 minutes to make the call.
brief_id: Tiga proposal. Satu rapat dewan. 90 menit untuk mengambil keputusan.

scenes.text: Three proposals. 90 minutes. I haven't even finished reading the first one.

id.text: Tiga proposal. 90 menit. Saya bahkan belum selesai baca yang pertama.

scenes.text: Use Bob. Give it the proposals, tell it what you need — it'll have a board-ready recommendation in minutes, not hours.

id.text: Pakai Bob. Kasih proposalnya, bilang apa yang kamu butuhkan — rekomendasinya siap dalam menit, bukan jam.

scenes.text: I've got 90 minutes before the board walks in. Alright. Show me.

id.text: Saya punya 90 menit sebelum board masuk. Baiklah. Tunjukkan.

scenes.text:
Alex opens IBM Bob.

Three vendor proposals.
One board meeting.
Time to get the full picture.

id.text:
Alex membuka IBM Bob.

Tiga proposal vendor.
Satu rapat board.
Saatnya mendapatkan gambaran lengkap.

scenes.text:
All three motions passed.

Bob caught something I'd have missed.
Board-ready before the meeting started.

id.text:
Ketiga motion disetujui.

Bob menemukan sesuatu yang hampir saya lewatkan.
Siap untuk board sebelum meeting mulai.

scenes.text:
Three proposals. One clear decision.

The analysis was mine.
The call was always yours.

id.text:
Tiga proposal. Satu keputusan yang jelas.

Analisisnya milik saya.
Keputusannya selalu milik kamu.
